# Bluebarry

Bluebarry is a customer data and product-advice platform for analyzing and synchronizing shopper identities and profiles.

Category: Data. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/bluebarry/.

## Actions

- **List Identities** (read-only): Return shopper identity records.
- **List Profiles** (read-only): Return raw, unmerged profile rows.
